ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-29-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name an Adult and a Minor
Comm. Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: M. Vallejo, Reporter: Karen Farnsworth
Petitioner: Inessa Pyatkovskaya, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Nikita Pyatkovskiy, was sworn and examined.
Petioner has submitted a declaration dispensing with notice to minor's father. Order granting the petion was signed in open court.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Adult's Name to: Inna Kupriyanova.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Minor's Name to: Nikita Kupriyanov.

Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-22-2005 Reset To Dec-29-05 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong.
Petitioner: Inessa Pyatkovskaya, present in pro per and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Nikita Pyatkovskaya, was sworn and examined.
After hearing the testimony presented, matter is continued to Dec. 29, 2005 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for Petitioner to bring the Minor's birth certificate, along with any document pertaining to the Minor's Name Change.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-08-2005 Reset To Dec-22-05 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Helen Sorep-Matley.
Petitioner: Inessa Pyatkovskaya, present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Nikita Pyatkovskaya, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor is continued to Dec. 22, 2005 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218, for the Petitioner to file an Affidavit and Declaration of Minor's birth father.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
